groups.title: Chapter treasures
groups.about: One sheet per grade: the treasure for each of its eight chapters, and the grade's own treasure for finishing them all. Each grade's set is made of one material, and the materials grow grander from kindergarten to 6th grade.
groups.style: They are rare, precious treasures from a storybook adventure, each a single object standing upright on its own, seen from the front or a slight three-quarter view, with a small sparkle of shine on metal and gems.

sheets.title: Kindergarten
sheets.set: painted wood and bright, glossy enamel, like precious toys

items.look: A small crown painted red, with five round gold dots in a row along its band and a yellow ball on each of its points.
A necklace of big round beads in a repeating pattern: red, blue, red, blue, red, blue, tied with a bow.
A round shield painted blue, with a yellow triangle, a red square and a green circle on its front.
Two golden bells hanging side by side from one wooden bar, one big and one small.
A round glass jar with a cork, holding a heap of red gems and blue gems mixed together.
A wooden scoop holding three seashells, with two more seashells tumbling out of it.
A little wooden board with exactly ten round holes, in two rows of five, like a ten frame: seven holes hold red marbles and three are empty.
A neat stack of ten gold coins, with four more gold coins in a little pile beside it.
A big plump golden star standing on a small round painted base, with a red ribbon tied around the base. The grandest of the nine.

sheets.title: 1st grade
sheets.set: polished bronze and warm copper, with teal and orange enamel

items.look: A round bronze medal hanging from a teal ribbon, with a raised plus sign on its left half and a raised minus sign on its right half.
A half-unrolled scroll with copper handles, showing three little painted apples and a curved arrow, with no writing.
Small bronze balance scales, perfectly level, with three orange gems on each pan.
Ten copper wands tied together in a bundle with a teal ribbon, with three loose wands lying beside the bundle.
A little bronze tower made of ten stacked rings, with a small orange flag on top.
A round bronze pocket watch on a short chain, its face marked with twelve little ticks instead of numbers, both hands pointing straight up.
A cloth banner hanging from a bronze pole, showing three rows of little fruit pictures, each row a different length.
A round bronze shield divided into four equal slices, two slices enamelled orange and two teal.
A tall bronze trophy cup with two curly handles and a big teal gem on its front, on a copper base. The grandest of the nine.

sheets.title: 2nd grade
sheets.set: shining silver, set with blue and green gems

items.look: An open silver coin purse, with ten small silver coins spilling out next to one big shiny coin.
A silver magnifying glass with a blue gem set in its handle.
A flat silver square made of a hundred tiny cubes, a rod of ten cubes, and three single cubes, all with blue edges.
A short silver sword whose straight blade is marked along one edge with evenly spaced tick marks, like a ruler, with a green gem in the hilt.
A small silver treasure chest with three round gem locks in a row on its front: blue, green, blue.
Two matching silver-trimmed pouches side by side, each holding the same number of green gems.
A shiny silver piggy bank with a coin dropping into the slot on its back.
A small silver mantel clock with twelve little ticks instead of numbers, its long hand pointing to the right and its short hand pointing straight up.
A tall silver crown set with blue and green gems. The grandest of the nine.

sheets.title: 3rd grade
sheets.set: gleaming gold, set with red and green gems

items.look: An open box holding golden eggs in three neat rows of four.
A round golden platter with four small, equal piles of red gems on it.
A round gold stopwatch with a red button on top and little ticks around its face.
A golden padlock with two keyholes, and two little golden keys beside it, one with a red gem and one with a green gem.
A rectangular golden shield covered in a grid of small red and green squares, like a checkerboard.
A golden pendant on a chain, its round face cut into eight equal slices, three of them set with red gems.
A small golden trophy whose top is a row of four golden bars of different heights.
A square of little golden fence posts and rails running all the way around a patch of green grass.
A tall golden goblet set with a ring of red and green gems. The grandest of the nine.

sheets.title: 4th grade
sheets.set: clear crystal and ice-blue glass, trimmed with gold

items.look: A small gold-framed abacus with clear crystal beads on four rods.
A crystal jug with gold tick marks up its side, half full of glowing blue water.
A gold hand mirror whose glass shows many copies of one blue gem in neat rows.
Three equal crystal jars of blue sweets in a row, with two sweets left over in front of them.
A gold drawing compass, the two-legged kind for drawing circles, opened to a square corner, with a crystal at its hinge.
Three little crystal bottles with gold stoppers, filled with glowing blue liquid to three different heights.
A gold bracelet set with ten crystals in a row, three of them glowing bright blue.
A rectangular gold window frame filled with a grid of ice-blue glass panes.
A crown of tall, clear crystal spikes on a gold band. The grandest of the nine.

sheets.title: 5th grade
sheets.set: deep midnight-blue enamel and gold, scattered with tiny gold stars

items.look: Three gold measuring spoons hanging on a ring, one big, one smaller and one tiny, each with a little star.
A tall midnight-blue wizard hat covered in rows of little gold stars.
A glowing blue gem held between two curved gold bands, like a pair of round brackets.
A round midnight-blue box whose lid is cut into six equal slices, five of them gold, with a star in the middle.
Three round golden moon cakes on a midnight-blue plate, each cut into four equal pieces.
A round gold tape measure with its midnight-blue tape pulled out, marked with gold ticks.
A clear glass box filled with little gold cubes stacked in neat layers.
A square midnight-blue map with a gold grid of lines, and one bright star sitting where two lines cross.
A tall, grand gold scepter topped with a big bright gold star, crisp-edged, with no glow around it.

sheets.title: 6th grade
sheets.set: carved green jade and gold, set with orange gems

items.look: Two jade bowls side by side, one holding two orange gems and the other holding three green gems.
One big jade cup with four small gold quarter-cups lined up in front of it.
Two gold gears with jade centres, one big and one small, their teeth fitted together.
A gold thermometer with a jade bulb and a white snowflake beside it, its red line low, below the middle mark.
A closed jade box with a gold lid and a star-shaped gold keyhole, glowing softly.
Gold balance scales, perfectly level, with a small closed jade box on one pan and a pile of orange gems on the other.
A jade box opened out flat into its six square faces, laid out in a cross shape and edged in gold.
Five small jade pillars in a row from shortest to tallest, the middle one topped with a gold cap.
A grand crown of carved jade and gold, set with orange gems. The grandest of the nine.

groups.about: The surprises a child finds when something learned days ago has stuck. Playful and a little silly, in no particular order.
groups.style: They are playful magical keepsakes, a little silly, each a single object on its own, seen from the front or a slight three-quarter view, with a small sparkle of shine on metal and gems.

groups.title: Question pictures
groups.about: The things questions ask children to count, compare and spot patterns in. Each shows as its emoji, which looks different on every device, until its picture is made; then the game uses the picture. (Coloured counters need none: the game draws them as circles.)
groups.style: They are counting pictures for young children, so each must be recognisable at a glance even when small: one simple object, a clear silhouette, little detail, no scenery, no ground or shadow beneath it, and no sparkles.
